name: AC Segmentation
summary: Segments axons in volumetric light-microscopy OME-Zarr data with the Allen Institute ac_segmentation RSUNet model and outputs a labelled OME-Zarr volume.
description: Runs the Allen Institute's segment_array.py with its bundled pretrained RSUNet checkpoint inside the gamorosino/ac-segmentation container, on CPU, using the first resolution level of the input OME-Zarr and an optional mask. Use it for automated axon segmentation of light-sheet or similar microscopy volumes.

inputs.description: Volumetric light-microscopy image (OME-Zarr); resolution level 0 is segmented.
Optional OME-Zarr mask restricting the segmentation.

outputs.description: Segmented volume (uint8-labeled OME-Zarr) produced by the RSUNet model.

parameters.description: Maximum intensity threshold used for contrast preprocessing before segmentation (segment_array.py --filter_max_intensity).
